metadata.title: Inkline: Webtoons and Comics
metadata.description: Read webtoons and comics on Inkline. The first {freeEpisodes} episodes of every series are free.

home.lead: The first {freeEpisodes} episodes of every series are free. Subscribers read new episodes {earlyAccessDays} days early.
home.status: We're building Inkline right now. Check back soon for the first series.

email.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verify.subject: Confirm your Inkline email
verify.intro: Welcome to Inkline! Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
verify.outro: This link works for 24 hours. If you didn't sign up for Inkline, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Inkline password
reset.intro: We got a request to reset your Inkline password. Use the button below to choose a new one.
reset.outro: This link works for 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email and your password stays the same.

login.title: Log in
login.verified: Email confirmed. You can log in now.
login.resetDone: Password changed. Log in with your new password.
login.verificationResent: We sent a new confirmation email.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.lead: Create your free account. The first {freeEpisodes} episodes of every series are free.
signup.checkEmail: Check your inbox: we sent a confirmation link to {email}. Confirm your email to finish signing up.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Pick a new password for your account.

twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.backupLead: Enter one of your backup codes. Each works once.

errors.invalidInput: Check your details: enter your name, a valid email and a password of at least {min} characters.
errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email first: we sent you a link when you signed up.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait about 10 minutes and try again.
errors.captcha: We couldn't verify you're human. Try again.
errors.captchaPending: Wait for the human check to finish, then try again.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.social: We couldn't log you in with that account. Try again or use your email.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.emailHint: Your email can't be changed yet.
profile.invalid: Check the fields and try again.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it logs you out of your other devices.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Adds a 6-digit code from an authenticator app to every log in.
twoFactor.mustSetUp: Admins must turn on two-factor authentication before using Inkline. Set it up below.
twoFactor.setupLead: Add Inkline to your authenticator app with the key below, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Save these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone.

creator.title: Creator
creator.readerLead: Publish your own webtoon or comic on Inkline.

creator.title: Become a creator
creator.lead: Tell readers who you are. You can publish series and episodes right after.
creator.penNameHint: Shown on your series. 2 to 40 characters.
creator.invalid: Enter a pen name of 2 to 40 characters and a bio under 500 characters.
creator.notAllowed: Your account can't become a creator.

studio.title: Creator studio
studio.lead: {count, plural, =0 {You have no series yet.} one {You have # series.} other {You have # series.}}
studio.empty: Create your first series to start publishing episodes.
studio.episodeCounts: {total, plural, =0 {No episodes} one {# episode} other {# episodes}} · {published} published

series.coverAfter: You can add a cover image right after you create the series.
series.title: Title
series.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. The series lives at inkline.com/series/your-address.
series.isPublishedHint: Readers can find a published series once it has a published episode.
series.invalid: Check the fields: a title, and a web address of 3 to 60 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
series.slugTaken: That web address is already used by another series. Try a different one.
series.noAccess: You don't have permission to change this series.

episodes.title: Episodes
episodes.count: {count, plural, =0 {No episodes yet} one {# episode} other {# episodes}}
episodes.empty: No episodes yet. Create the first one.
episodes.cannotMove: This episode can't move there: published and processing episodes keep their numbers.
episodes.locked: This episode can't be changed any more.
episodes.noAccess: You don't have permission to change this series.

episode.heading: Episode {number}
episode.statusNotice: This episode is {status}, so it can't be edited.
episode.title: Title

accessModeHints.free: Anyone can read it as soon as it is published.
accessModeHints.early_access: Subscribers read it first. It becomes free 7 days after publishing.
accessModeHints.subscribers_only: Only subscribers can read it, always.

episode.scheduledAtHint: In your local time. Leave empty to publish as soon as the pages are processed.
episode.scheduleInPast: Pick a publish time in the future.
episode.locked: This episode can't be changed any more.
episode.noAccess: You don't have permission to change this episode.
episode.pagesLead: Upload the episode's images in reading order, then submit them for processing.

upload.rateLimited: Too many uploads at once. Wait a minute and try again.

problems.type: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are accepted.
problems.size: This file is too big (the limit is 20 MB).
problems.width: This image is wider than 2000 px.
problems.unreadable: This file isn't a readable image.

upload.rules: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to {size} MB each · up to {width} px wide
upload.tooMany: An episode can have up to {max} pages.
upload.submit: Submit {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} for processing
upload.submitHint: Wait for every page to finish uploading (retry any that failed).

submitErrors.incomplete: Some pages haven't finished uploading. Retry them and submit again.
submitErrors.queueFailed: We couldn't start processing. Try again in a moment.

processing.lead: We're preparing your pages. This page updates by itself when it's done.
processing.retryHint: If a page is the problem, replace it below and submit the episode again.
processing.retryFailed: We couldn't start processing. Try again in a moment.
processing.scheduledReady: Your pages are ready. This episode will publish on
processing.published: Published. {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} ready for readers.

failure.not_image: Page {page} ({fileName}) isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP image. It may be another kind of file with an image name.
failure.unreadable: Page {page} ({fileName}) is damaged and can't be read as an image.
failure.too_large: Page {page} ({fileName}) is too big. The limit is {size} MB per file.
failure.too_many_pixels: Page {page} ({fileName}) has too many pixels. Cut a very long page into two parts.
failure.missing_original: Page {page} ({fileName}) is missing from storage. Upload it again.
failure.no_pages: This episode has no pages to process.
failure.failed: Processing didn't finish after several tries. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact support.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.lead: Your account doesn't have permission to open this page.
